title: Citus: cluster status (coordinator, workers, Patroni groups, shards)
description: The future nexus-cli CitusAdapter `status` verb -- prints the distributed-cluster membership from pg_dist_node (coordinator + 2 active worker primaries, by VIP), each Patroni group's leader/replica (coord / worker1 / worker2), and the shard placement summary for the `events` distributed table. Read-only; safe to run anytime.

observe.what: table: pg_dist_node -> {groupid 0 coordinator coord.citus.nexus.lab, groupid N worker1.citus.nexus.lab, groupid M worker2.citus.nexus.lab (all isactive)}; Patroni: citus-coord/worker1/worker2 each 1 Leader + 1 Replica; events shards split across both workers

sudo -u postgres psql -h /var/run/nexus-citus -d citus -c 'SELECT * FROM pg_dist_node ORDER BY groupid' + 'SELECT nodename,count(*) FROM citus_shards GROUP BY nodename' -- the raw source the verb wraps
sudo /usr/local/sbin/nexus-patronictl list citus-coord -- Patroni leader/replica per scope

whatProves: The CitusAdapter reads distributed-cluster topology (pg_dist_node) + Patroni group state + shard placement and renders a one-shot health view -- the input to every other verb (failover-test, scale-out).
